description: Open-licensed instrument and sound recordings for Gravitunes. Only CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and University of Iowa MIS files. fetch.py downloads them to data/earth/instruments/<id>/.

missing.shakuhachi: FluidR3_GM shakuhachi renders are not served by the CDN (jsDelivr package limit); flute is used instead
missing.xylophone: FluidR3_GM xylophone renders are not served by the CDN; marimba is used instead
missing.kora: no CC0/CC BY/BY-SA kora recording on Commons (one FAL track, otherwise spoken words); app uses the harp sample
missing.morin_khuur: no CC0/CC BY/BY-SA morin khuur recording found; app uses the cello sample
missing.balalaika: no open balalaika recording found (only word pronunciations); app uses the banjo sample
missing.tabla: Commons 'Tabla drums demo.oga' (CC BY-SA 3.0, ~270 Hz strokes) is usable, but no map region plays a tabla yet

samples_description: Small repitchable one-note samples for the app (sound-engine/library/samples/, committed): fetch.py --samples downloads each zone's url, cuts start..start+dur, makes it mono 32 kHz, fades the tail and encodes MP3 48 kb/s. f0 is the recorded pitch in Hz (nominal C3 for unpitched drums). Licences: MIT, CC0, public domain only.
